source_caption_text:
#LilPump, whose real name is Gazzy Fabio Garcia, is an American rapper from Miami, Florida, born on August 17, 2000. He rose to fame during the explosion of the SoundCloud rap movement in the mid-to-late 2010s, building a huge online following with his energetic delivery, colorful personality, short catchy songs, and signature “Esskeetit” catchphrase. Alongside artists such as Smokepurpp, Pump became one of the most recognizable faces of that era of internet-driven hip-hop.

Lil Pump’s career took off in 2017 with “Gucci Gang,” which became a massive viral hit and climbed to No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100. The success helped turn him from an internet rapper into a mainstream name while he was still a teenager. His self-titled debut album, Lil Pump, arrived that same year and included collaborations with artists such as Gucci Mane, 2 Chainz, Rick Ross, Chief Keef, and Lil Yachty. He followed it with Harverd Dropout in 2019, which featured songs such as “Esskeetit,” “Drug Addicts,” “Butterfly Doors,” and “Be Like Me” featuring Lil Wayne.

Pump also scored another major hit when he teamed up with Kanye West for “I Love It” in 2018. Beyond his music, Lil Pump became known for his wild social-media presence, bright hairstyles, jewelry, tattoos, and over-the-top image, all of which helped make him one of the most recognizable rappers of his generation. Although his mainstream commercial peak came during the late 2010s, he has continued releasing music, including his third studio album, Lil Pump 2, in 2023. His biggest impact remains his role in the SoundCloud era, when artists were increasingly able to turn viral internet followings into major rap careers.
